{{Top|leg}}
The '''Perkell Sector Mining Fleecing''' was a criminal fraud perpetrated in the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]] by the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Janstren Brell]] and his [[Red & Black League]]. It was a large swindle that netted Brell the interest of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] on crimes of conspiracy and fraud.
